direction: Dusk wide from the churchyard bank: the cross in silhouette, and below it the folds of the hill, a wooded cwm, and the Ely marshes running to the distant estuary. Slow pull back.

still.prompt: photoreal 16:9 cinematic wide still, around AD 1000, dusk on an inland hilltop, silhouette of a carved stone cross and a small church, the land falling into a wooded valley and broad river marshes leading to a distant estuary, last light low on the horizon, no people, no text, no heraldry, not on a coast

captions.text: 1392: a family research note cites a reference to Cwm-Cedwyn in Llandough boundary records. The record is not yet held, and its contents are not confirmed.
